description:
Define the taxonomy-initialised CLI test repository once in shared test support, so the suite copies can be retired.

## Background

`TaxonomyRepo` and its constructor `setup_test_repo_with_taxonomy` are defined twice, in `crates/jit/tests/cli_issue/main.rs` and `crates/jit/tests/cli_query_graph/main.rs`. Each is a thin wrapper over `jit::test_utils::setup_test_repo_with_taxonomy` that pairs a temporary repository with the `TestTaxonomy` declaration that authored its vocabulary, so a subprocess test reads type names from that declaration. `cli_query_graph/main.rs` adds `type_label`, `membership_label` and `membership_namespace` helpers.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: Shared test support, beside `TestTaxonomy`, defines `TaxonomyRepo`, its constructor and the label helpers, with the behaviour of the suite copies.
- [hard] REQ-02: A unit test proves the repository declares the taxonomy it carries.

## Notes

The CLI process fixture can take ownership of this repository; the taxonomy stays with the test that reads it. The suite copies are retired by each suite's own adoption.
title: Shared taxonomy repository type for CLI tests
